title: Linear score equals queried-coordinate score
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $0<p<1$, and let $T$ be a decision tree on sign inputs with real-valued outputs that computes $f$. Under the product distribution in which each sign is $-1$ with probability $p$, the mean of $f(x)$ times the sum of all standardized coordinate signs equals the mean of $f(x)$ times the sum restricted to the coordinates queried by $T$ on input $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite coordinate set of size n
A real-output decision tree on sign inputs
A function f on sign inputs
